name: sdocx-bridge
description: Let Claude read Samsung Notes (.sdocx) and PDFs, transcribe note recordings locally, write into them in your own handwriting, and fill photos or scans of paper notes in realistic ballpoint handwriting that follows the printed lines.
long_description: Inkbridge runs on your computer. Claude can open .sdocx and .pdf files from your Downloads, Documents and Desktop folders (and any folders you add), look at every page, read stroke timing, transcribe recordings with a free local Whisper model, and write text in your handwriting as vector ink: PDF ink annotations, or new strokes added to a copy of the Samsung Notes file. Originals are never modified and nothing is uploaded. It can also fill a photo or scan of a paper note: it finds the printed lines (even when the page is bent), the boxes and what is already written, and writes your handwriting there so it looks like real ballpoint ink that was scanned.

prompts.name: read_handwriting
prompts.description: Read every handwritten page of a note

prompts.description: Transcribe the recording and fill what is missing from the notes in my handwriting
